description: Sparse mouth-animation rows keyed by voice ID for the unique-pair voice sequencer. The traced C++ consumer uses only the last matched row's ApplyTiming as an end-of-talking cutoff while a sound module has an AtomComponent; MouthType and AnimationTime on these rows are serialized but have no observed C++ read.

Id.simple: Unique row key for one mouth-animation keyframe row.
Id.technical: FName row key (export property ID; import key Id). All 4,447 exported keys are unique and follow <Id_Voice>_<two-digit cue index> (for example VoBtl_CN_210_Intro_1_011010_00). The traced evaluator never looks a row up by this property: FGameDataTableArray::GetRows enumerates UDataTable row names in table-then-row-name order, and the evaluator then filters by Id_Voice. This is a serialized row identity with no observed behavioral use in the available source.

Id_Voice.simple: VoiceDataTable row ID whose playback this keyframe group belongs to.
Id_Voice.technical: FName into VoiceDataTable. All table rows are collected, then retained only when Row->Id_Voice equals the resolved voice ID; that same base ID is what UAbramsSequencerSoundModule::FindSoundRow uses to fetch the VoiceDataTable cue row. GameManager.Settings.StudioByte_371 is the voice-language flag (0 selects Japanese voice cues; nonzero selects the English-cue '_En' suffix, also mirrored to GameSoundManager::bAppendEnVoiceSuffix). Under the nonzero flag the evaluator appends '_En' to the ID used for mouth-row filtering, matching the suffix the sound manager applies to the cue actually played. Every exported Id_Voice, including its _En variants, resolves to a VoiceDataTable row key.

MouthType.simple: Mouth-pose enum stored on the keyframe; no use by the traced consumer was found.
MouthType.technical: EGameCharacterFacialPartsMouth (uint8 enum: None, Close_01, Open_01, Open_02, Invalid=255); the row constructor defaults this member to None. All 4,447 exported rows use only Close_01, Open_01 or Open_02; no None or Invalid rows are present. The traced unique-pair evaluator never reads this property: its cycling shapes come from CharacterMouthPatternDataTable.MouthTypeArray, where None entries are sentinel values removed before use. Any effect of this row property outside that evaluator is unresolved.

ApplyTiming.simple: Voice playback time, in seconds, used as the last-row end-of-talking cutoff.
ApplyTiming.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f. Matching rows are kept in table order and are not sorted. In UpdateLipSync, when SoundModule->GetAtomComponent() is non-null, bTalking = !MouthAnimRows.IsValidIndex(LastKey) || PlaybackTime < MouthAnimRows[LastKey]->ApplyTiming; the comparison is strict, so the last row's value is the cutoff at which talking ends. With no AtomComponent, bTalking stays false regardless of rows; with an AtomComponent but no matching rows, the negation makes talking indefinite. The export has two rows for 2,222 Id_Voice groups (first row 0.0, final cutoff 0.16666667-5.8333335 s) and three single-row groups whose only ApplyTiming is 0.0, so row order matters because no sort is applied.

AnimationTime.simple: Serialized per-keyframe float whose exported values look like seconds; no C++ read was found.
AnimationTime.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f. Exported values range from 0.0 to 2.8333333 s (many are 0.083333336 or 0.16666667, but not all are sub-second). No read of this row member was found in the available consumers; the unique-pair evaluator takes its shape duration from CharacterMouthPatternDataTable.AnimationTime and its stop fade from EndAnimationTime instead. The purpose of this per-row value is therefore serialized but behaviorally unresolved here.

notes: Loaded through the 'DataTable' primary asset type as the single named asset CharacterMouthAnimDataTable into DTM.CharacterMouthAnimDataTables (+0x580). The manager waits for all primary assets to finish loading, skips null tables, and the evaluator collects rows through FGameDataTableArray::GetRows; no numbered shards or table aliases are registered for this table in the source or export.

This table and CharacterMouthPatternDataTable have complementary roles: anim rows bound the talking interval by voice ID, while the target's pattern row (selected by character/NPC model ID from DTM +0x590) provides the cycling mouth shapes and fade times. The anim row's MouthType and AnimationTime are not substituted for the pattern row's values in the traced consumer.

Rows are only loaded on the play-request path of FAbramsSequencerPlayVoiceForUniquePairEvaluate::OnExecuteMasterTrack, and UpdateLipSync is called only for FirstCharacter and NoBindingNPC target types when a mouth module exists. Other voice-selection paths such as PlayVoice_2D have no mouth path in this evaluator.

The companion export contains one table asset with 4,447 unique rows across all checked shards/variants; the site row-key index matches every exported key. These are the available content only and are not asserted to be the complete retail set.

All 2,225 exported Id_Voice values exist in VoiceDataTable: 1,085 are _En variants and 1,140 are base IDs. VoiceDataTable also has _En cue rows for all 1,140 base IDs, but only 1,085 of those base IDs have _En mouth rows in this export; the other 55 can select an empty MouthAnimRows group when the nonzero voice-language flag is active.

FAbramsSequencerPlayVoiceForUniquePairEvaluate::UpdateLipSync is marked DIFF in status/verdicts.json:73122 (quote at :73124: 504 unmasked byte differences, 736 vs 741 B), so exact retail bytes are not proven. The field roles above follow the reconstructed source and the observed linkage, with byte-level caveats retained.

AGENTS.md states retail Blueprints contain no logic. No retail Blueprint consumer of this row struct was identified in the available source or asset-text survey; the partial Content tree does not provide independent retail Blueprint proof beyond that project-level finding.

usages.detail: Defines the 'DataTable' primary asset type used by the table loaders.
Declares the CharacterMouthAnimDataTables array at DTM +0x580.
Requests the table as a primary asset during initial loading.
GetRows enumerates every row in each registered table in table-then-row-name order; this table has one registered table, with no sorting by ApplyTiming.
Row loading and lip-sync update are gated on IsPlayRequested and the mouth module; UpdateLipSync is invoked only for FirstCharacter/NoBindingNPC targets.
Appends '_En' to the voice ID used for row matching when the voice-language flag is nonzero.
Filters collected rows by Id_Voice of the selected (possibly _En-suffixed) voice.
Takes MouthAnimRows.Num() - 1 as LastKey without sorting; the last collected matching row controls the cutoff.
Uses the last row's ApplyTiming as the end-of-talking threshold only when an AtomComponent exists; no rows means talking indefinitely.
FindSoundRow resolves the unsuffixed voice ID against VoiceDataTable for the cue actually played.
GetLocalizedVoiceCueName appends '_En' to the played cue name under the same voice-language flag.
Sets the voice-language flag and mirrors it to GameSoundManager::bAppendEnVoiceSuffix.
